program='''def transform(grid):
    rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if 3 in row]
    cols = [c for c in range(len(grid[0])) if any(grid[r][c] == 3 for r in range(len(grid)))]
    r0, r1 = min(rows), max(rows)
    c0, c1 = min(cols), max(cols)
    return [[grid[len(grid) - 1 - r][len(grid[0]) - 1 - c]
             for c in range(c0, c1 + 1)]
            for r in range(r0, r1 + 1)]
'''
